feeds.title: CyRAACS Blog
feeds.description: CyRAACS is founded by industry veterans, Suresh Iyer and Murari Shanker, who have close to 3 decades of experience in Technology, Information Security, Data Privacy, Risk Management, and IT Operations. Their focus is to tailor and integrate their solutions into client environments seamlessly, so they can focus on their core business completely. Learn about the latest cyber security threats and how to protect yourself with their cyber security blog.

feeds.title: Cyberops Blog
feeds.description: Cyberops is India's leading organization in the field of Information security. They foster certified training on Information Security and provide penetration testing for security audits, and Cyber Crime Investigation services for various sectors to meet their specific needs. The blog features articles discussing cyber security in detail.

feeds.title: Seqrite Blog
feeds.description: Seqrite is the Enterprise Security brand of Quick Heal Technologies Ltd. Launched in 2015, Seqrite's products and solutions are defined by innovation and simplicity. A combination of intelligence, analysis of applications, and state-of-the-art technology, it is designed to provide continuous and better protection for enterprise corporate customers. The blog features articles on XRD, cyber security, and more.

feeds.title: Kratikal Blog
feeds.description: Kratikal is renowned for its cutting-edge security solutions. It offers a comprehensive selection of penetration testing and vulnerability assessment services, as well as security auditing for PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001. It is designed to provide the assistance needed to improve your company's cyber security posture. Keep up-to-date with the latest news, articles, surveys, and research on cyber security.

feeds.title: GBHackers on Security
feeds.description: GBHackers on Security is a Cyber Security platform that covers daily Cyber Security News, Hacking News, Technology updates, and SOC Resources, Kali Linux tutorials. Their mission is to keep the community up to date with happenings in the Cyber World. Their blog features technological articles, cyber security, AI, and more.

feeds.title: Cyber Security Hive Blog
feeds.description: Cyber Security Hive was founded when two cyber security consultants from Amazon and Capgemini decided to come together as a team to chase their dream of making the digital world a secure place by bringing forth revolutionary changes in the cyber security domain. They use their research data to create modules for Information Security Awarenesses Training Programs. Get the latest news, articles, hacking tricks & various other security-related content on the blog.

feeds.title: Quick Heal Blog
feeds.description: Quick Heal Technologies Ltd. is the pioneer of antivirus research and development in India and has set the benchmark of computer security standards. The brand simplifies security management to ensure an uninterrupted digital experience for all users across multiple devices and platforms. The blog shares articles on IT security news, alerts, threats, tips, and more.

feeds.title: Data Security Council of India Blog
feeds.description: DSCI is a not-for-profit, industry body on data protection in India, set up by NASSCOM. It makes cyberspace safe, secure, and trusted by establishing best practices, standards, and initiatives in cyber security and privacy. The mission is to create trustworthiness for Indian companies as global sourcing service providers. The blog features some advanced technological articles.

feeds.title: The Cyber India Blog
feeds.description: Internationally acclaimed social initiative and award-winning blog. They write about issues and topics that matter in a common netizen's internet life. They try to be precise and to the point. The blog features Splinternet, which governs the internet, Digital India, AI, and more.

feeds.title: Kaushal Bhavsar Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Kaushal Bhavsar is a professional in the field of cybersecurity and has shared his wealth of knowledge and experience during his experience of 12 years in the field. Read informative articles about cybersecurity topics, news, scams, and more professional insights.
